correctness.rationale: An all-size projection proof identifies the undamped maximal invariant subspace via dissipativity and constructs the detector-observable projector. Single-particle ±sqrt(pq),0 sectors lead to positive Gram eigenvalues (p-2)/p,(p-1)/p (and q analogues). Equal hopping merges sign-zero and zero sign-sign sectors, with explicit 2x2 constant Gram block. Exceptional unequal ratios 2:1 and 1:2 do not mix trivial and standard irreducible detector representations. Exact projector contributions yield each probability. Replayed independent full-matrix verifier: 35 spectral cases, 2290 sitewise probabilities, 6 lossy spectra, max error 6.44e-15; finite tests are corroborative only.

value.rationale: Exact collision reaction on both balanced and imbalanced bicliques is a motivated benchmark. The theorem exhibits a universal discontinuity of 2(p+q)-2 absorbing modes and an exactly halved opposite-color reaction probability under exact velocity resonance, independent of all positive local loss strengths. It is an infinite-family complete classification with a nontrivial Gram-sector mechanism, not a numerical sample or parameter renaming.
